C_ABG.statement: Simultaneous compact arithmetic nodal-parameter gluing for finitely many punctures and arbitrary nilpotent boundary, including Frobenius-permuted punctures.

L_ABG_GRADING.statement: A canonical generalized-primary-space cocharacter over the original coefficient field grades the entire multiplier eigenspace of Ad(A), without semisimplicity or regularity.

L_ABG_COMPACT.statement: One compact open J and one prime-to-l degree e contain every boundary conjugator, with all prescribed arithmetic transport squares.

L_ABG_COVER.statement: One Kummer cover with prescribed first jets is geometrically connected, totally ramified at all markings, and retains exact arithmetic boundary transports.

L_ABG_LIFT.statement: The finite-field arithmetic tower lifts through simultaneous proper root stacks, retaining its full boundary homomorphisms and geometric compact image.

L_ABG_GLUE.statement: Independent inertia- and arithmetic-compatible fiber identifications glue the finite torsors at every balanced node; their entire tower lifts to the smoothing.

L_ABG_COMPONENT_ORBITS.statement: Geometric special and generic connected-component partitions on the framed fiber of a proper flat tame root/nodal-curve torsor agree, including disconnected torsors.

L_ABG_DENSITY.statement: First-component monodromy embeds in generic monodromy at every finite quotient and hence in J, proving geometric density.

N_ABG_NOVELTY.statement: The combined arithmetic theorem has independently established originality and publishable significance beyond a known-result reconstruction.
